name: Aurans
source:
"You have been chosen to shoulder heavy burdens and great powers. You will be granted an exceptional chance, Rowan Alanna Nightingale."

When homely nobody Rowan Nightingale gets hit by a car, she doesn't die, but instead is chosen to become an Auran - a being who can make anything happen, on three conditions: she has to be able to imagine it, believe it, and then create it. Taken under her mentor's wing, she travels to other dimensions and learns to harness the power of her imagination, slowly growing more confident in herself. But dark forces are lurking in the shadows, and who better to manipulate than a young, naïve Auran such as her? Soon, Rowan must fight her inner demons - quite literally - in order to save the dimensions from being destroyed. 

But can you truly believe that you are stronger than the darkest, most evil force in the entire multiverse, when all your life you have believed you weren't worth anything at all?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871030/Aurans/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“罗温·阿兰娜·南丁格尔，你被选中了。你将肩负重担，也将拥有强大的力量。这是难得一遇的机会。”

罗温·南丁格尔其貌不扬，一向毫不起眼。遭遇车祸后，她竟活了下来，还被选为“奥兰”。奥兰能让任何事成为现实，只消满足三个条件：想象得出，相信它能成真，再亲手创造它。在导师的引领下，她前往其他维度，学习驾驭想象力，也渐渐有了自信。然而黑暗势力正在暗中窥伺。还有谁会比这样年轻天真的奥兰更容易操纵？不久，为了让各个维度免遭毁灭，罗温必须直面自己的心魔——那可是真真切切的恶魔。

可一个从小就认定自己一无是处的人，真的能相信，自己比整个多元宇宙中最黑暗、最邪恶的力量还要强大吗？

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871030/Aurans/]Steam[/url]］
